cause_quote: The role launch added `if (!role || role.agents === "*" || role.agents.includes(params.agentId))` to session creation and run-start authorization while the existing `agents.list` handler still returned the unfiltered roster.
user_saw: A user with a restricted operator role saw agents they could not use in the Control UI picker and agent directory.
summary: The fix filters Gateway agent discovery by the caller’s current role and makes the Control UI reconcile its selection against the live roster.
reasoning: The operator-role launch created the mismatch by restricting session creation and runs while the existing picker continued to consume an unfiltered `agents.list` response. I checked the roster handler before and at the role launch and verified that the later catalog refactor and model-policy changes carried the unfiltered roster forward.
